why: Drops the muzzle offset, so the flash goes off inside the tank rather than at the barrel opening. That is not a cosmetic slip: it turns issue #356's WEAPON-LOCAL candidate into a second tank-local one, which is the treatment `ring` already occupies, and the comparison would then be run on two arms that are the same idea. The position is the same point bullets.ts hands a real `fire` event as its flash (SHELL_MUZZLE_FORWARD along the turret), so this also breaks the arm's whole premise -- the shot's own visual, in the shot's own place.
killedBy: blocked-fire muzzle flash (issue #516, parent #356) sits at the MUZZLE, on the barrel centreline -- not on the tank
